reader.requirement: At --std 85 data-name-1 of a relative START KEY phrase, which may be qualified (SR2), must be the very data item named in the RELATIVE KEY phrase of the file's ACCESS MODE clause; any other item (same name under another qualifier, an unrelated item, a group, a record of the file, a reference-modified slice, a RENAMES alias) and any KEY phrase on a file with no RELATIVE KEY are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Year == 2002 only: whether an OCCURS-subject operand is screened by 2023 SR4 or compared by its subscripts; false at 85 as at 2023
Edition.Year < 2002: mandatory INVALID KEY (SR3), another rule

reader.edition-search: The identity test is `!ReferenceEquals(operand.DenotedItem, file.RelativeKeyItem) || ConstantOccurrence mismatch` in BindStart's relative arm, with no edition test.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb602_start_key_identity is the positive control (the key itself, RENAMES storage sharing); refusal of a same-named item under another qualifier, an unrelated item, a group, the record, and a file with no RELATIVE KEY are not exercised by it

probes.printed: COBOL0862 'data-name-1 shall be the RELATIVE KEY item' at lines 30 (RK2 OF OTHER-KEYS), 33 (unrelated LONE), 36 (RK2 OF KEYS (1:2)), 39 (66 RK-ALIAS RENAMES RK2), 42 (group KEYS), 45 (file with no RELATIVE KEY: item '(none)'), 48 (record XF-REC) (exit 65); identical at --std 2023
probes.expected: each operand that is not the RELATIVE KEY item is refused (§1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR4)

probes.printed: F1=NIK 00 / F1 REC=EEEE RK=0005 / F2=IK 23 / F3=IK 23 / F4=IK 23
probes.expected: the qualified RELATIVE KEY item binds; NOT LESS THAN 0 positions on record 5; NOT < 9999, = 0 and > 6 raise invalid key (GR4 b, GR10)

probes.printed: S4 REC=AAAA FS=00 (START YF KEY IS EQUAL TO RK2 OF KEYS where OTHER-KEYS also holds an RK2)
probes.expected: the qualified RELATIVE KEY item is accepted (SR2/SR4)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR4  (║4.7.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: BindStart's relative arm compares the operand's DenotedItem with file.RelativeKeyItem by reference, so qualification resolves to the one item and every other item, slice or alias is refused with COBOL0862; the 85 path takes the same arm as 2023. The message cites §2023 SR5 rather than the 1985 rule, message-only.

refuter.evidence: stkey-001 at --std 85, refused COBOL0862 each time: START YF KEY = XK (another file's RELATIVE KEY item, line 33); START XF KEY > YK (line 36); in a contained program, START on the GLOBAL file GF KEY = GK, where GK is the contained program's own local item with the same name as the outer non-GLOBAL RELATIVE KEY item GK (line 49). That proves the check is identity, not name. stocc-001: a table element TK(1) refused COBOL0862 'subject to an OCCURS clause' (KeyedIoBinder.BindStart; SubscriptedClauseOperands is false at 85). That is right for 1985, because a RELATIVE KEY data-name cannot name a table element. A subscript on the non-OCCURS key XK(1) refused COBOL2096. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.3 SR4  (║4.7.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR4.
